aria: Animated recap of the Grizzlies' 136 to 120 road win over the Wizards: Cameron Boozer's 3-pointer with 8 minutes 52 seconds left in the third quarter, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his career-high 29 points, the top scorers, how the Grizzlies won, and the next game at Cleveland.
notes: Box score from the Memphis Grizzlies' 136–120 road win over the Washington Wizards at Capital One Arena on Nov 16, 2026, from the Sports Illustrated box score and play-by-play, with game details from the Associated Press (via NBC Washington), Field Level Media (via 107.5 The Game and JOX FM) and Grizzlies On SI. All 136 Memphis points and all 120 Washington points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals: 35–33 Washington after one, 69–59 Washington at the half, 101–87 Memphis after three. Team totals (field goals 53 of 95 to 40 of 85, threes 16 of 37 to 11 of 32, free throws 14 of 17 to 29 of 36, assists 42–25) are the players' totals in the box score; rebounds 48–31 are the players' rebounds. Biggest leads: Washington 12 at 69–57 late in the second quarter (AP; Field Level Media), Memphis 22 at 136–114 with 1:10 left (play-by-play). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Monday's games.

Washington led 73–63 after Anthony Davis's step-back with 10:56 left in the third. Memphis answered with 10 straight: Cedric Coward's floater, Boozer's threes at 9:16 and 8:52, and Zach Edey's layup off a Boozer pass at 8:11 to tie it 73–73 (play-by-play; the AP and Field Level Media both describe the 10–0 run). A 9–0 burst later made it 87–79, and Memphis won the quarter 42–18 on 16-of-24 shooting (Field Level Media; Grizzlies On SI). Boozer's 29 points were a career high; Memphis tied its franchise record with 42 assists and is 7–0 on the road; Washington has lost eight straight (AP; Field Level Media). Ty Jerome missed the game with a sore right hip (AP). Memphis plays at Cleveland on Wed, Nov 18 at 7:00 PM ET (Covers schedule).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Cameron Boozer's 3-pointer off a Cedric Coward pass with 8:52 left in the third quarter, his second three in 24 seconds, which cut Washington's lead to 73–71 (play-by-play). The recaps don't describe the move, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Memphis Grizzlies or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Boozer's listed 6-foot-10 and 250 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his 7-foot-1.5 wingspan measured at the 2026 draft combine (Yahoo Sports; On3), in Memphis's road blue with No. 27 (Basketball-Reference). He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
